content: Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this medication and how it pertains to your specific health needs. Children aged 11 years or younger should only take the liquid form of nitazoxanide, not the tablets. Antibiotics are most effective when the medication level in your body remains consistent, so it is crucial to complete the full prescribed course, even if symptoms improve after a few doses. Common side effects may include headache, nausea, or stomach/abdominal pain. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States or Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Before taking nitazoxanide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. The liquid form of this medication contains sugar, so caution is advised if you have diabetes. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, and it is unknown if it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only and should not be used for other conditions unless directed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. For the liquid form, discard any unused medication after 7 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
